description: When rmapi upload failed and .rmapi config was missing, told David to manually re-register rmapi from a terminal instead of reading and following the remarkable-upload skill. The skill has an explicit protocol for handling corrupted or missing .rmapi config (delete-and-retry, and if re-registration is required, report that clearly). Should have invoked the skill from the start rather than attempting raw osascript rmapi calls and then punting re-registration to the user.
correction: Read IES/.claude/skills/remarkable-upload/SKILL.md first. Follow its pre-push checklist and Corrupted rmapi Config recovery section. The skill defines exactly how to handle a missing .rmapi file — delete and retry, and if interactive re-registration is needed, say so with that framing, not a generic 'you need to re-register.'
systemic_fix: Always read the remarkable-upload skill before any rmapi operation. Do not attempt raw rmapi osascript calls outside the skill. The CLAUDE.md already says 'read the skill first' — enforce it.
